texts.zh:
[from.GetName]独特的构造与地质特征，造就了罕见而壮丽的奇观。行星大部分区域是酷热的沙漠，充斥着火山烟雾与流动的熔岩。一块巨大坚固的大陆岩石板块从地壳中隆起，高耸于地表数十公里。由此形成的高原凌驾于有毒云层之上，孕育着本地动植物，形成繁荣的生态系统。

该高原不仅适宜许多物种栖息，还可能蕴藏着惊人的科学奥秘。
texts.en:
The unique composition and tectonics of [from.GetName] has created an unparalleled marvel. While most of the planet is a hot desert clogged with volcanic smog and free-flowing lava, one massive continental plate of solid rock rises dozens of kilometers above the average surface. The resulting highlands, high above the layer of toxic clouds, are home to a verdant green ecosystem of native plants and animals.

This plateau would be readily habitable for many species and could hold a number of fascinating scientific insights if it were to be studied.
